scope: M0 engineering only; synthetic value labels; no RL or method-benefit claim
source_episode_rule: First existing sft-train episode per task, frame 0 and its full 32-step action chunk
value_target_origin: Synthetic constant for gradient routing only; not a return or success label

optimizer: AdamW; adapter/head clipped separately; no weight decay
